title: Degreewise scalar pullback chain tower comparison
statement: For finite coefficient fields E,L,F over Q_l with maps iota:E→L and j:L→F, every scheme morphism f:X→Y, every cochain complex P of completed E-coefficient modules on Y, and every degree i, the degree-i components of the two composites in lem-pur-integral-scalar-pullback-chain-tower are equal.

source.place: Finite pullback generators, consecutive reduction squares, and unshifted and shifted Roos coordinate calculations in scalar-comparison proof step 9.

proof.text: Prove that additive Roos comparisons respect a natural transformation F composed with G to H. Product projections reduce the product comparison equation to naturality of that transformation. The unshifted Roos coordinate and the shifted degree i-1 coordinate then give the same composite, by the normalized Roos and tower-map coordinate formulas. The cocone biproduct identity determines each degree from those two coordinates. Use naturality of the Roos comparison to move the first tower map through the second scalar comparison, combine the three strict Roos maps by functoriality, substitute [lem-pur-integral-scalar-pullback-tower-composition], and apply the proved Roos composition lemma. Taking degree i gives the stated equality.

proof_origin.place: The existing finite-generator, strict-tower, and two Roos-coordinate plan, implemented by proved private helpers in the item module.
